label: Some receipt gives present-tense reception and correlativity iff concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed result, attribution deferred: for every history, giving relation and reception predicate, there is a receipt interpretation (a value of the primitive present-tense receipt, definition 506ea036) satisfying both the present-tense reading of reception and correlativity of receiving and giving iff weak concurrent actualization 40a97664 holds. Forward by the derivation from the two premises; backward by the standing-composition sense (RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_2), on which the present-tense reading holds and correlativity is 40a97664. So the pair, with its receipt interpretation left open, says exactly what 40a97664 says; it can carry further content only through a fixed reading of receipt.
